study.question: Does averaging relevance evidence from every other field preserve useful within-slot information without depending on the arbitrary cyclic field order, and does any benefit require target-coordinate correspondence?
study.hypothesis: Observed r0022 click AUCs are cyclic 0.6645388696, same-field 0.6643094194, common 0.6641913851, null 0.6638196973, at identical 32295406 parameters. These single-seed results motivate, but do not establish, complementary-field information. For event e and item field f, let s[e,f]=cos(target[f],history[e,f]). Replace cyclic score s[e,f-1] by the symmetric exclusion average (sum_j s[e,j]-s[e,f])/(F-1), then retain mean(value)+0.5*Cov(score,value) within each existing slot. This removes arbitrary field ordering while retaining the event pairing and all fixed readouts. A mapping-by-query-orientation factorial tests whether exclusion benefit depends on semantic coordinate matching. Earlier feedback routing underperformed uniform compression (r0001 versus r0000); source-gradient gating recovered performance (r0003); full100 and slot-first replacements also underperformed their respective parents. Thus neither more event computation nor more feedback resolution is assumed useful.

nearest_work.difference: Read archived primary text lines245-306, especially Eq3 and unnormalized interest intensity. Inherit local activation over compressed summaries, but use parameter-free within-slot field-score/value covariance before readout; not an exact DIN reproduction or a verified originality claim.

Inspected pinned 90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d source lines157-214: flatten sequence and context, tokenize and mix. Here retain masked grouped statistics and field-conditioned covariance, with no flattened-history tokenizer or UniMixing stack. The original paper paper:unimixer has no detailed authorized text; fallback benchmark section2.3 read. Global nearest-work completeness and novelty remain unverified.

Nearest successful local alternative; replace a one-field cyclic score assignment with the mean of all other fields. No additional parameter or new scorer population. Existing common/same-field/null receipts remain architectural references; direct current factorial uses common controls.

inherited_components: DIN adapted embeddings, shared local activation and four task towers
Recent-biased 10 temporal partitions with three overlapping behavior populations, occupied-row scoring and unnormalized count weighting
Auxiliary source-gradient gates; temporal/behavior residuals; union identity residual; aligned centroid angular correction
Target-query live-gradient covariance value transport with coefficient0.5 and unchanged action common-score channel
study.proposed_difference: Only the transport score construction changes: complement versus common field averaging, crossed with normalized target coordinates aligned versus circularly shifted by one inside each field. Query rotation affects only transport, never scorer, angular, target/context or identity features. All four sources instantiate identical modules and compute both field-mixing alternatives; no new learned parameter, timestamp, label input, feature, data pass or history position is introduced. Complement is symmetric under a simultaneous relabeling of field groups, eliminating dependence on the cyclic order in this operator. This is a local implementation difference; no global novelty is asserted.
predictions: Predeclared primary exclusion contrast D_A=AUC(complement_aligned)-AUC(common_aligned) is positive; >=0.00015 is a practical screening signal, not a significance threshold. Report the exact difference even if negative.

Target-specific complementary evidence predicts positive factorial interaction D_A-D_R, where D_R=AUC(complement_rotated)-AUC(common_rotated); rotation may itself alter baseline quality so its marginal effect alone is insufficient.

If order-invariant complementary averaging is useful, complement_aligned should approach or exceed historical cyclic AUC0.6645388696 while avoiding cyclic-order dependence. Historical comparison is provisional until matched reproduction/seeds; failure to beat cyclic is a valid negative result.

All cells have 32295406 trainable parameters, unchanged slot/scorer counts, and similar forward cost. No efficiency improvement is predicted from parameter-free status. Measure all four task AUC/Logloss, full-population click AUC, history slices including empty histories, peak memory, train/wall time and inference throughput/latencies through host receipts.
Common_aligned should reproduce g2-r0022-shared_reproduction within host numerical variability. Material discrepancy requires a source/initialization audit before attributing exclusion effects.
falsifiers: D_A<=0 undermines this implementation of symmetric complementary mixing; it does not refute all cross-field conditioning.
D_A-D_R<=0, or equally strong rotated gains, undermines the target-coordinate-specific explanation even if absolute AUC improves.
Complement improves only by sacrificing cost materially or is worse than the existing cyclic model: retain the current incumbent and report a failed averaging direction.

Any extra parameter, padding/empty-slot leakage, changed module initialization, new scorer population or common-control mismatch invalidates the claimed matched attribution and triggers host diagnostics before interpretation.
alternative_explanations: Single seed and many prior validation selections can favor a chance maximum; no confidence interval or repeated mechanism support is available.

Exclusion changes score variance and gradient routing as well as field membership; common-versus-exclusion is not variance matched. A later norm/variance-matched control is required if the contrast is promising.
Averaging several fields can dilute a strong specific partner; a failed mean cannot reject sparse complementary relations.

A fixed coordinate rotation is not independent noise: shared embeddings can adapt to it, and it changes gradients/geometry. It tests a concrete equivariance disruption, not the absence of target information.

Common score removal of self has F-dependent strength; F remains fixed. The action score is common within each orientation, so its orientation effect is a confound for marginal orientation comparisons but is held fixed in each exclusion contrast.
Offline feedback maturity and whole-window vocabularies remain inherited limitations. Read industry provenance is not evidence that an external architecture caused the local gain.
